text: No, and my previous message was wrong. From the Moon (~384,400 km), no individual human-made structure is visible to the naked eye; Earth appears as a small disc, and even continents are barely discernible. The Great Wall is only about 5-9 m wide and blends with the surrounding terrain, so it's hard to pick out even from low Earth orbit (~400 km). Astronauts, including Yang Liwei, China's first astronaut, have reported not seeing it unaided.
